Description

 

This Cross-Party Group was dissolved at the end of the Sixth Senedd (8 April 2026)

 

 

Purpose

 

Cross-Party Group on Autism is a forum to raise awareness and promote the interests of autistic people, their families and carers in the Senedd and the Welsh Government.

 

 

Office-holders

 

Chair: Mark Isherwood MS

Secretary: National Autistic Society
